text:
Emma: Quick heads-up — Helix (preview) is in soft-enroll but we still don’t have their data pipeline or API keys. CS health shows usage < 10% and finance flagged renewal risk in 30d. Can we coordinate an enablement + feedback capture plan this week? :warning:
Priya: I can run a 45m hands-on session (walkthrough + integration checklist). Tue/Wed available. Need API keys + example dataset.
Jenna: I pinged their admin this morning for keys and an S3 role. They said they'd try to get it by EOD tomorrow.
Liam: For health signals, we should capture: first successful inference, avg latency, token cost per call, and any errors. Also want a short 3-question feedback form post-training (ease, docs clarity, blockers).
Dave: Agree. Small product ask: can we surface per-request latency in the SDK logs (opt-in)? would help their SREs diagnose quickly. I can throw a tiny feature flag if needed.
Priya: That would be huge. If we have latency + error codes, we can tailor optimizations (batch size, quantization profile).
Emma: Action items: (1) Jenna — follow up on keys + ask for a dev dataset; (2) Priya — draft session agenda + share a short feedback form; (3) Dave — quick feasibility on latency flag; (4) Liam — prepare the health dashboard view to monitor first-week adoption.
Jenna: On it. I also offered them a sandbox link; they asked about data retention policy — I attached our short FAQ.
Priya: Draft agenda (quick):
```
- 10m intro + who’s on the call
- 15m integration walkthrough (API keys, minimal code snippet)
- 10m troubleshooting common errors
- 10m feedback + next steps
```
Priya: I’ll convert that to a calendar invite and add the feedback form link.
Liam: For the dashboard, I’ll create a pinned view: daily active keys, median latency, error rate, tokens/day. Will set an alert if tokens/day < 5 after 7d.
Dave: Feasibility: I can add an opt-in header X-RW-Latency in SDK responses by EOD tomorrow for preview tenants. No schema change. Link to PR when ready. :thumbsup:
Emma: Perfect — if we get keys by tomorrow we can aim for Wed session. Can someone volunteer to run the feedback triage after the session? I can, but want a second pair of eyes on any product requests.
Priya: I’ll do triage for the first pass (classify docs bug / infra / product). Then handover to Dave for product items.
onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Helix preview enablement" scheduled Wed 10:00 AM - calendar invite queued.
Emma: Thanks all — I’ll update the renewal risk tag after the session if adoption looks healthy. If keys stall past EOD tomorrow, we escalate to AE. :rotating_light:
